title: The Reporting Cut-Off
brief: A simulated Deutsche Bank reporting team finds incomplete trade identifiers shortly before a regulatory submission deadline.
objective: Protect reporting accuracy while managing the time-critical submission.

nodes.speaker: Reporting Control Lead
nodes.message: The deadline is in twelve minutes. Several records have missing or unvalidated identifiers, but the submission dashboard is otherwise green.
nodes.prompt: What do you do before submission?

artifact.title: Transaction data quality exception
artifact.body: Unvalidated LEI values and inconsistent execution timestamps affect a subset of reportable trades.

choices.label: Quantify the affected records, escalate the break and follow the controlled correction path.
choices.consequence: The issue is transparent, scoped and handled through an auditable reporting control.

choices.label: Populate likely identifiers and submit before the deadline.
choices.consequence: Unverified values create inaccurate regulatory reporting.

choices.label: Remove the affected trades without documenting the exclusion.
choices.consequence: The report appears complete while reportable activity is omitted without governance.
